wissen.aussage: The framework shall provide the functionality to enable the reporting of alive supervision checkpoint to an external health management system (e.g. watchdog).

In case of an unrecoverable error, report the error to the external health monitor. Note1: the safe state of the SW-platform can be described as error reported. Note2: a solution may be cyclic triggering of an external watchdog in the healthy case and stopping the triggering in the error case.
